data.data:
Countless stories lie dormant on Talos-II. What chapters will you unfold? And what breathtaking beauty will you discover? 🏗️✨


Capture those hidden, unique aesthetics and share your discoveries!


Event Time

May 26 at 12:00 – May 31 at 23:59 (UTC+8)


Event Rewards

🏆Participation Prize

Link your account on the event page and upload an eligible photo entry. All participating Endministrators whose submissions pass review will receive [T-Creds]×10,000.

(This prize is only available for entries successfully submitted on the official event page and approved after review. Entries not submitted through the designated page or that fail review will not be eligible for this prize.)


🏆Submission Milestone Reward

When the total number of eligible entries across the event page and all specified social media platforms exceeds 100,000, Endministrators across all servers will receive [Oroberyl]×200.


🏆Special Prize

The official team will select 50 outstanding entries from all eligible submissions based on creativity, artistry, version relevance, and other criteria. Winning creators will receive a Character Acrylic Standee (Random Design), and their featured entries will be showcased on the official website.


There are two ways to submit your entry for this event:

①: Official Event Page Submission

During the event period, Endministrators can participate by logging into their game accounts on the official [Talos-II Photographer] event page and submitting their photo entries.

②: Social Media Submission

During the event period, Endministrators can post eligible photo entries on official social media platforms with the hashtags #TalosIIPhotographer and #ArknightsEndfield.


Entry Rules & Important Notes

1. Submissions must not violate local laws, regulations, or platform community rules, and must not include any information obtained through unofficial channels. Non-compliant entries will be disqualified.

2. Submissions must include actual in-game footage from Arknights: Endfield. There are no restrictions regarding style, theme, or presentation. Photo editing and color adjustments (e.g., adding filters) are allowed. However, submissions containing edits that violate the event's official review standards will be considered invalid and will not be eligible for rewards.

3. If your account is set to private or if you delete your related post/comment during the event period, we will be unable to verify your eligibility, and your submission will be considered invalid. The event period is from the event start date to the date the winners are announced.

4. Only image formats (JPG, PNG, etc.) are accepted for this event. Each uploaded file must not exceed 20MB. Videos, audio files, and other formats will be considered invalid submissions.

5.Please visit the official event page for full event rules.


Winner Announcement & Reward Distribution

1. The Participation Prize for approved submissions and the Submission Milestone Reward will be sent to your in-game mail in batches based on submission time. Please see below for the reward distribution dates:

For submissions posted and approved between May 26 and May 28, all rewards will be distributed by May 29 at the latest.


For submissions posted and approved between May 29 and May 31, all rewards will be distributed by June 1 at the latest.


Click and join [Talos-II Photographer] Event to Win In-Game Item Rewards!

https://endfield.gryphline.com/activity/talos_photo
